methods.label: Circumcenter location
methods.explanation: The circumcenter of an acute triangle lies inside the triangle, the circumcenter of a right triangle is the midpoint of its hypotenuse, and the circumcenter of an obtuse triangle lies outside the triangle.
methods.levelReason: Uses the standard Grade 9 classification of circumcenter locations.
